title: Optional Coverage Add-Ons: Riders Held Across a Customer's Contracts
content:
**Rule.** Under the Optional Coverage Add-Ons a customer may hold any number of riders across their base contracts. There is no maximum number of riders per customer.

How many riders of one kind a single base contract may carry, and which riders exclude each other, is decided per base contract by the rule on riders per base contract, not by any count across the customer's contracts.

| Question | Answer under this rule |
|---|---|
| Is there a ceiling on the riders one customer holds in total? | No; the number is unlimited. |
| What is counted when a rider limit is applied? | The riders on the one base contract concerned. |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A customer with two homeowner service contracts and one rental property service contract holds a Bridgewell Well Pump Rider on each of the three. Nothing in this rule limits that total; whether each base contract may carry its rider is answered contract by contract.
